newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 19 killed in India warehouse blast-agency.
newsitem.headline: At least 19 killed in India warehouse blast-agency.

text.p: At least 19 people were killed in an explosion in a warehouse in India's western state of Maharashtra on Thursday, the Press Trust of India said.
It said the blast in a construction warehouse near the town of Satara injured another 23 people.
The news agency quoted a district official in Satara as being unsure of the cause of the blast.

The United News of India, in a separate report on Thursday, quoted police in the state capital Bombay as arresting a man they alleged to be planning to kill Bal Thackeray, leader of Maharashtra's rightwing Hindu Shiv Sena party, with a bomb.
It said the Moslem man, identified by police as Abdulla Salafi, was planning to target Shiv Sena's offices on Wednesday, on the anniversary of a string of bomb blasts in Bombay on March 12, 1993.
Some 260 people were killed in the attacks that were linked to underworld Moslem gangs, apparently seeking revenge for the demolition of a 16th century mosque by Hindu militants in December 1992.
